scoring_justification: Peak reflectivity, peak wavelength, and FWHM are recomputed from the raw reflectivity CSV and compared to paper-reported performance thresholds; no trust in self-reported metrics.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for peak reflectivity, peak wavelength range, and FWHM bandwidth
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures/caption: design reflectivity >0.98, peak near 1064 nm, bandwidth >5 nm. These are the reported performance thresholds.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and task plan: peak reflectivity >= 0.98, peak wavelength within 1050-1080 nm, FWHM >= 5 nm.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These thresholds correspond to the paper's actual design specifications for α=70°, not arbitrary numbers.

outputs.description: Computed normal-incidence reflectivity spectrum for the golf-tee diamond mirror design. The checker recomputes peak reflectivity, peak wavelength, and full-width at half-maximum from this spectrum and compares them to hidden paper-reported thresholds.

output_contract.notes: The agent must ensure the CSV covers the 1000–1200 nm range with sufficient wavelength sampling to resolve the resonance. The checker will derive scalar metrics from the spectrum, not trust any self-reported summary.
